transcript: Rub a cotton pad soaked in alcohol on these three points of your body and remove all the negative energy you carry. Tomorrow, when you wake up, you will understand why. This is one of the oldest personal cleansing practices that exist. Simple, quick and incredibly powerful. Take a cotton pad and soak it well with alcohol. Hold it between your hands for a few seconds. Close your eyes and say quietly, absorb everything I carry that does not belong to me. You are giving it an order. You are telling the cotton pad what it needs to do for you. Now rub it slowly on the back of your neck. The back of the neck is where everything you hold in builds up. All the tension from the things you never say, then rub it on both temples in gentle circles. The temples are where the thoughts that never stop get stuck. The worries that spin around in your head every night. And finally, rub it on your navel, your energy center, the first point through which you received life. Everything you absorb from the world passes through there whether you know it or not. While you do this, repeat out loud, I return all the harm that does not belong to me. Everything I absorbed from others I release here when you finish look at the cotton pad. If it is yellowish or darker than normal, it is not just the alcohol. It is what your body was holding without you knowing. Now burn it, watch it burn, and visualize how everything that is not yours leaves with that fire. Do this for three nights in a row before bed. The first night cleans the surface, the second goes deeper, and the third seals the cleansing. On the fourth day, you will notice the difference. Your body lighter, your mind clearer, and a calm you have not felt in a long time. And do not be afraid of what you discover. Be afraid of how long you have been carrying all of that without doing anything about it. Not all exhaustion comes from the body. Sometimes what weighs you down cannot be seen, but it can be felt. Write in the comments I release if you are going to do this tonight and come back in three days to tell me how you feel. And if you feel that it is not just your body that needs cleansing, but everything you carry inside, the fear, the stress, the emotions, nobody taught you how to let go of. I have spent over 20 years learning in silence how to do exactly that. And everything I know is inside the way back to stillness. The link is in my profile.
